# ScatterPlot3DElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasScatterPlot3DElement` · **Group:** [Charts](../Groups/Charts.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasScatterPlot3D.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasScatterPlot3D.h) · `#include "Plugins/Charts/UltraCanvasScatterPlot3D.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasChartElementBase`](UltraCanvasChartElementBase.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

An (x, y, z) point cloud in an orbitable axes box

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasScatterPlot3DElement> CreateScatterPlot3DElement( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasScatterPlot3DElement(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
